purpose: Aggregate region production families so the large build reuses validated shared kits instead of duplicating textures, props, materials and memory across the trilogy.
target_profile: i7 Gen6 / 8GB RAM / ~2GB VRAM / DX11 / 720p Low-Medium / 30 FPS floor
reuse_principles: Prefer one shared technical kit per repeated family, then region-specific dressing/material identity on top.
Keep hero silhouettes and canon-critical landmarks region-specific.
Do not create a global hard-reference hub; heavy kits stay soft referenced and asynchronously streamed.
Repeated world detail uses ISM/HISM and authored LOD/culling.
Shared support kits do not override canon identity or region-specific art direction.

families.runtime_rule: Use soft references; repeated instances use ISM/HISM where applicable; do not hard-reference every region kit from a global manager.
